Zelda and Grand Theft Auto headline the nominees for the 2027 Game Awards
The numerous categories of The Game Awards were largely dominated by Grand Theft Auto VI and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, but there's plenty to talk about in this year's nominees.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
November 17, 2026
schedule
2 Min Read
Image via Rockstar Games
The Game Awards has revealed its 2026 nominations, chosen by a jury of video game journalism outlets and content creators, showcasing the biggest and many of the most critically-acclaimed games of the year getting their flowers in nominations.
The biggest award, Game of the Year, is dominated by a number of major releases from the year, including one that has not had reviews published yet.
007 First Light
,
Control Resonant
,
Phantom Blade Zero
, Resident Evil Requiem, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, and the currently-unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI make up the Game of the Year category, which has a small degree of influence from user votes.
While four remakes have been nominated for Game of the Year since 2014, no remake has ever won the award. That has not stopped
Ocarina of Time
from being nominated in multiple categories, with the remake of the 1998 classic snagging nominations in four total slots. But that's nothing compared to Grand Theft Auto VI, which is nominated in seven categories including Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, and Best Score and Music.
